transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the pre-exercise review for Saturday's production failover. We've got the staging failover tests behind us, and the window is 10 AM to noon on Saturday. Before I approve the runbook, I need to check in with site reliability engineering and data protection as part of our normal review process. Who's representing SRE and data protection on this call?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Riley. I'm representing SRE on this call. I need to flag something important before we proceed with runbook approval. During an unrelated capacity investigation this morning, I discovered a production-shaped replication lag issue that directly affects the failover exercise. I'd like to share that finding now so it's on the record for your review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Riley. I'm representing data protection on this call. I have a matter I need to raise before runbook approval as well, but please go ahead, Mina — I'd like to hear your replication lag finding first so we can address both concerns together in this review.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for being here. Mina, please go ahead and share your replication lag finding. Owen, I want to hear your concern as well right after. Both of these need to be on the record before I make any decision on the runbook. Let's hear Mina first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During an unrelated capacity investigation this morning, I replayed a production-shaped queue and confirmed that replication lag becomes unsafe at 25% write traffic. It only recovers after a 30-minute observation period at a 10% write-traffic level. I have not yet updated the exercise runbook with these findings, which is why I'm flagging it now before you make any approval decision.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to raise a data protection concern before runbook approval. I confirmed with the privacy team this afternoon that the Aster and Boreal tenants are contractually restricted to processing in the EU primary region only. They must be excluded from this secondary-region failover exercise. I found this clause during a separate contract review and haven't filed the routing exception yet, so it wouldn't have appeared in any prior screening.
transcript.speaker: A3

Riley to record the final operating limits of 10% write traffic cap, 30-minute observation period, and Aster/Boreal tenant exclusions, and grant runbook approval once updates are confirmed.
